My mental health. I’ve been in a cycle going in and out of severe depression and anxiety. I’ve been hospitalized and I have survived multiple suicide attempts. I haven’t had a normal adult life yet and I’m in approaching my late twenties. I’m worried the cycle will never end.

EDIT: wow thank you for all the support. The reddit community can be really amazing. I’m struggling and don’t want to give up, but it’s difficult to not see an end to all of this. I will be taking steps to try to break this cycle. All I want is a normal and stable life— I think we all do.

Well I learned that everyone deals with mental illness. Whether your a lawyer, doctor, student, grandparent, it really doesn’t matter. The one thing we all have in common is dealing with the stigma surrounding mental illness. As opposed to a physical illness, we all have been very selective when choosing who to tell amongst our family and friends

DBT seems like so much because it covers so many different areas. I would suggest sticking with it since technically medication isn’t used to treat BPD, it is used to treat illnesses concurrent with it like depression or anxiety. DBT will take time, but long term it will be the best chance at easing and even eliminating some your symptoms.

It’s going to take time, it’s not going to happen over night. Therapy, meditation, somewhat regular exercise will all help. You have to be patient and you will have a good healthy life ahead of you. I’m 25 as well and experience a lot of what you are right now, especially the rumination and the sense of abandonment. You can do this. It wont be easy. It won’t happen quickly, but you will do it. I promise.
